title: AdapFair: Ensuring Adaptive Fairness for Machine Learning Operations
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on a framework for ensuring adaptive fairness in machine learning operations concerning demographic attributes like race, gender, and age, particularly under conditions of data drift or changing fairness requirements.
